key_themes: Rising Treasury yields (10-year at 5.24%, 19-year high) pressuring equities
Oil spike on U.S.-Iran tensions after Trump rejected Strait of Hormuz reopening deal
AI tech dominates headlines: Nvidia buyback, AMD acquires World Labs, MongoDB CEO exits to Meta

stocks.reason: Shares surged ~156% after Phase 3 DAYBREAK trial of Zenkuda (tarcocimab tedromer) met all primary endpoints in wet age-related macular degeneration; 54% of patients achieved 6-month durability at year one
Stock fell ~18% after CEO CJ Desai announced departure to join Meta as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer; Dev Ittycheria named interim president and CEO
Shares dropped ~7% after FAA said it will not certify the 737 Max 10 until it assesses a newly discovered software glitch
Stock fell ~4% after announcing $8.2B all-stock acquisition of World Labs, an AI spatial-intelligence research firm co-founded by Fei-Fei Li; market concerned about valuation
Outperformed market, rising ~1%, after announcing a new $150B share buyback authorization and unveiling a software platform for AI developers to set agent safeguards

Shares fell ~8% on a September 28 lead-plaintiff deadline in federal securities litigation over alleged misleading disclosures on Chinese scandium oxide supply reliance; Oracle also invoked force majeure on Project Jupiter
Jefferies downgraded to Underperform from Hold with $38 price target (18% downside) citing slower-than-expected monetization growth in U.S. and Canadian markets
Led non-S&P market gainers with a +13.5% surge, benefiting from oil price spike driven by U.S.-Iran geopolitical tensions pushing crude toward $95/bbl

S&P 500's weakest performer, falling ~6.3% on no specific catalyst, likely reflecting broad risk-off rotation out of cybersecurity names amid rising yields
KeyBanc upgraded to Sector Weight from Underweight, joining a wave of clean-energy analyst actions following improved domestic manufacturing outlook
Deutsche Bank downgraded to Hold from Buy and cut price target to $138 from $155, citing softening consumer spending trends and ongoing volume pressures in North America
Jones Trading initiated with Buy rating and $70 price target, citing strong AI data center pipeline and improving capital structure
